description: The same schedule over a fixed OCCURS: the table is four entries because the copybook says so, there is no count item and the layout carries no copybook-reading statement, because there is no OCCURS DEPENDING ON for one to settle. It is the third of the three tables a schedule has to be available over, and it is here so that the availability is stated by entries rather than only by a specification: a mechanism available under a fixed OCCURS and under one reading of an OCCURS DEPENDING ON but not the other would make a copybook describable or not according to which compiler wrote the file it arrived with. Both records hold all four entries and therefore two work entries and two slack runs, at the same two offsets -- which is the thing the pair is free to vary and this entry deliberately is not.
